texts.value: Hydrolyzes 3-hydroxyisobutyryl-CoA (HIBYL-CoA), a saline catabolite. Has high activity toward isobutyryl-CoA. Could be an isobutyryl-CoA dehydrogenase that functions in valine catabolism. Also hydrolyzes 3-hydroxypropanoyl-CoA
Highly expressed in liver and kidney, also detected in heart, muscle and brain (at protein level). Not detected in lung

disease.description: An autosomal recessive inborn error of valine metabolism. It causes severely delayed psychomotor development, neurodegeneration, increased lactic acid, and brain lesions in the basal ganglia.

texts.value: The disease is caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry
Belongs to the enoyl-CoA hydratase/isomerase family
